base_cycle = (7, 9, 1, 3, 5)  # This matches rows 20, 25 which have mod 0

def get_cycle_for_row(r):
    """Get the 5-element cycle for row r based on row index modulo"""
    mod = r % 5

def find_row_pattern(row):
    """Find the 5-element repeating cycle for this row"""
    # Look at consecutive non-zero values after position 2
    seq = [row[c] for c in range(3, w)]
    
    # Find candidate 5-cycle from first few values
    if len(seq) < 5:
        return None
    
    candidate = tuple(seq[:5])
    
    # Verify it matches all known positions in this row
    full_sequence = tuple(candidate[i % 5] for i in range(len(seq)))
    match = all(full_sequence[i] == seq[i] for i in range(len(seq)))
    
    if match:
        return candidate
    
    # Try other alignments
    for offset in range(1, 5):
        partial = seq[offset-1:] + seq[:offset-1]
        cand = tuple(partial[:5])
        full_seq = tuple(cand[i % 5] for i in range(len(seq)))
        if all(full_seq[i] == seq[i] for i in range(len(seq))):
            return cand
    
    return None

# Test our pattern finding

for r in range(3, 12):

    """Fill zeros using vertical periodicity observed in demo"""
